title: PBA: Rondae Hollis-Jefferson set for TNT return vs Macau

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Rondae Hollis-Jefferson will make his much-awaited return on Tuesday when TNT takes on hapless Macau in the PBA Governors’ Cup at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. The Tropang 5G activated the three-time Best Import on the eve of the 5:15 p.m. contest after a lengthy recovery from an Achilles injury sustained last year. “With RHJ back on the floor, TNT looks to build on its collective effort and carry renewed energy into the next stretch of the conference,” the Tropang 5G said in a statement released Monday.
